reason: The pain is real — I switch between Claude Code and Cursor all day and re-pasting context kills me — but I buy dev tools only after checking Reddit, GitHub issues, and Twitter first, and this is launch day with no track record, no audit, and nobody I know vouching for it. I'm not handing a stranger's local daemon my code, sessions, and credentials for $30 a seat.
objection: Unknown vendor, no reviews on Reddit or GitHub, no security audit, no one I trust has used it — and I'd be giving a local daemon from an unproven company access to my code and credentials.
would_change_my_mind: A third-party security audit, public source or a self-host option, and real reviews from engineers I know confirming the cross-agent handoff actually works.
